rationale: Paper 2412.05220 investigates the gamma-ray emission from millisecond pulsars in globular clusters, providing new evidence on their contribution to gamma-ray flux, which is relevant to understanding the gamma-ray flux of 47 Tuc. However, it does not fully resolve the discrepancies between predicted and observed spectral properties.
